collections.title: Programming PyTorch for Deep Learning
collections.summary: Ian Pointer’s book archive: notes for chapters 0–6, three associated notebooks, a chapter 2 download script and the whole-book PDF. Chapters 4–6 are heading-only outlines.

collections.title: React - The Complete Guide 2025 (incl. Next.js, Redux)
collections.summary: Udemy course archive with authored section notes, lecture resources and 363 distinct source snapshots organized under 34 modules. Starting, intermediate and completed versions keep their own file trees.

groups.title: Chapter 0: Preface
groups.summary: Book preface introducing PyTorch, deep learning and GPU computing.

groups.title: Chapter 1: Getting Started with PyTorch
groups.summary: Getting-started notes on computing environments, PyTorch setup and tensors, with the PyTorch Basics notebook.

groups.title: Chapter 2: Image Classification with PyTorch
groups.summary: Image-classification notes with the associated notebook and supporting image-download script.

groups.title: Chapter 3: Convolutional Neural Networks
groups.summary: Convolutional-network notes and the associated notebook covering convolutional and pretrained models.

groups.title: Chapter 4: Transfer Learning and Other Tricks
groups.summary: Heading-only outline for transfer learning, learning rates, augmentation and ensembles.

groups.title: Chapter 5: Text Classification
groups.summary: Heading-only outline for recurrent networks, embeddings and text classification.

groups.title: Chapter 6: A Journey into Sound
groups.summary: Heading-only outline for sound data, spectrograms and audio classification.
